author: Kevin Kelly
description: Community tools for first-time autoroles, sticky roles, welcome and goodbye embeds, solo voice disconnection, and member seen/presence statistics. Direct seen/activity commands and /community settings are included. Add safe persistent self-role menus, solo voice exemptions/warnings, tracking/DM switches, recorded voice hours, bounded daily participation totals, weekly digests, and guided setup. Includes bounded persistent community polls, event RSVPs, optional private reminders, and matching slash commands. Adds temporary voice ownership, explicit rules acceptance, opt-in birthdays, recurring events and capacity waitlists. Adds optional native Discord event mirrors, ordinary voice/external destinations, title/time edits, cancellation and repeating-occurrence reconciliation. Local RSVP consent stays separate from Discord Interested subscriptions. Welcome/goodbye templates reject unsafe format costs before rendering. Bot-owner administrator recovery stages a fresh isolated role, verifies a completed fresh member list for unexpected holders, and never adopts existing names, and member-controlled CSV display names are neutralized for spreadsheets.
short: Self-service roles, greetings, voice time, and weekly summaries.
install_msg: Load with [p]load communityplus, then use [p]community help and [p]community diag. Solo voice disconnection starts enabled with a 900-second timeout; use [p]community vcsolo disable to turn it off while configuring the cog. Enable slash commands as the bot owner with [p]slash enablecog communityplus, then [p]slash sync. Use [p]community setup for guided settings and [p]roles for configured self-service roles. Use [p]event native <ID> for an optional Discord Events-tab mirror.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-guild settings for autoroles, sticky-role preferences, welcome/cya message targets, solo-voice idle settings, and compact-embed preference. It also stores, per member, last-seen timestamps for message/voice/join/leave/presence, presence status history (last online/offline), and counters for messages sent, voice joins/moves/leaves, stream/video starts, activity starts (playing/streaming/listening/watching/competing/custom), and per-game launch counts. It also stores lifetime voice seconds and bounded daily participation totals, self-role menu IDs, solo exemptions, and weekly digest settings. Server settings include room hubs, onboarding rule text and safe roles, and birthday announcement policy. Temporary room records store owner IDs and creation timestamps (up to 50 rooms); user deletion anonymizes ownership. Member celebration records store opted-in birthday month/day, annual delivery markers, temporary role expiry and accepted-rules hash/timestamp. User hooks export/delete these records. Ordinary message contents are not stored. Poll/event records additionally retain their documented bounded participation data. Stores bounded poll/event records, titles/options, creator and announcement IDs, times, member votes/RSVPs, private reminder opt-ins, and sent markers. User-data hooks export/delete personal choices and creator attribution; already delivered Discord messages remain. Optional native Discord event mirrors retain event/server/channel IDs, start/end times, safe sync error types and up to five older occurrence IDs within those bounded event records. Interested-user lists are not collected. Native events remain on Discord after unloading.
